description: Guest asks about thermostat or wants to change temperature. Real per-unit logic: neutral 'make sure using the remotes' language (do not accuse of using Nest), direct to wall remotes. (Live Kumo status + auto-fix of mixed modes added in later enhancement.)
guestMessage: How do I turn up the heat? It's cold in here.

earlyThermostatInfo.recommendedResponse: Casey, Please make sure you are using the heat pump remotes on the wall in each room — the Nest thermostat (if you see one) does not control the AC or heat. We've gone ahead and turned on the heat pump for you and set it to 72°F. It should warm up within 20-30 minutes. You can also adjust it yourself using the remotes on the wall in each room. All of the wall units (living room, master bedroom, and small bedroom) need to be on the same mode — either all heat or all cool. If one is on heat and another is on cool, they will not work.
